mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declines by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decrease over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declines by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter during a late-cycle expansion.
